figurative_meaning_en: Oppression; persecution; display of power; use of force
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জোরজবরদস্তিতে গ্রামের লোকেরা ক্ষুব্ধ হয়ে উঠেছে।
জোরজবরদস্তি করে কোনো কাজ সফল হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The villagers are upset with his use of force.
Nothing succeeds through coercion and oppression.
note: Variations reflect emphasis on forceful imposition in Bengali linguistic tradition
